      · cases hx with

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro a b hr μ
  cases hr with
  | bisim h =>
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (h.follow_fst hx).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩,
              fun x hx => (h.follow_snd hx).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩⟩
  | choice h =>
      unfold lts
      constructor <;> intro x hx <;> cases hx <;>
        grind [IsBisimulation, Bisimilarity, ChoiceBisim]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro a b hr μ
  cases hr with
  | bisim h =>
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (h.follow_fst hx).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩,
              fun x hx => (h.follow_snd hx).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩⟩
  | choice h =>
      unfold lts
      constructor <;> intro x hx <;> cases hx <;>
        grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity, ChoiceBisim, HomBisimilarity.refl]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩

      exact ⟨(h.follow_fst ·).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩,
             (h.follow_snd ·).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨tr, .bisim hb⟩⟩

                | exact (h.follow_snd hp).imp fun _ ⟨tr, hb⟩ => ⟨Tr.choiceL tr, .bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR hs => exact ⟨x, Tr.choiceR hs, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl x)⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro x y (hc|hb)

    · exact .bisim hb.symm
  · rintro x y (hc|hb) μ z hz
    · cases hz with

      | choiceR hs => exact ⟨z, Tr.choiceR hs, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl z)⟩
    · grind [Bisimilarity.follow_fst, ChoiceBisim]

    · grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity, Bisimilarity, ChoiceBisim]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ _, .choice h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x y (hc|hb)
    · exact .choice hc.symm
    · exact .bisim hb.symm
  · rintro x y (hc|hb) μ z hz
    · cases hz with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hc.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ t => ⟨Tr.choiceL t.1, .bisim t.2⟩
      | choiceR hs => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR hs, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · exact (hb.follow_fst hz).imp fun _ t => ⟨t.1, .bisim t.2⟩
